description: WP-G2 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) ASSAULT VEHICLE (Coronus Grav-Carrier) through the real UI. Fixture cus11e_g2_assault_vehicle: P2 (Custodes) is active, the Custodian Guard are embarked in the Coronus. Real clicks select the Coronus, pick 'Advance' and 'Confirm Movement Mode'; the Coronus is dragged 4" and a real click on 'End This Unit's Move' ends the advance move. The Guard's unit-list row now reads 'Click to Disembark' (18.04 would bar an advanced transport); a real click opens the Disembark dialog, which names the ASSAULT VEHICLE shock disembark (rapid mode: 3", no charge) with its OK button enabled. A real click on Disembark and three real board clicks set the Guard up wholly within 3" of the hull: they are on the battlefield and not eligible to declare a charge.
